violations.description: Food supplies. — --Food item obtained from unapproved source. -Reusing egg cartons with an expiration date of 10/9/2025. -Staff on hand could not verify where the food is obtained from.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -A box of onions are being stored on the dry-storage floor next to the chest freezer.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -The front sanitation bucket by the roller dogs was tested at 0ppm Quat. The staff fixed this issue during inspection.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Cooked/seasoned chicken in zip log bags are not date marked.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -The ice machine behind the bar has build up on the ice shoot.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -The facility has test strips for lactic acid but use Quat for their sanitation buckets and Chlorine for their wash machine.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -The acoustical ceiling tiles above the kitchen are not smooth.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -A box of lettuce was found stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Ice dispenser has build up on the plastic shoot leading into the bin and needs cleaned.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Acoustical tile for the drop ceiling is installed above the food prep area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -The walls and fan shrouds for the walk-in cooler are in need of cleaning. There is a dusty build up on fan shrouds and the walls have a residue that need cleaned.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food with bare hands.-Food service employee was using bare hands while preparing toppings for prep table. i,e. lettuce, onions

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Food items on the floor of the walk in cooler and dry storage. (box of ham, chicken in walk in cooler and napkins in dry storage.
